cohort: Women who delivered between 2007-2011, grouped by platelet count
finding: Women with severe thrombocytopenia at delivery had a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery, low birth weight infants, low Apgar scores, and cesarean sections, and lower use of regional analgesia/anesthesia.
mod_finding: Women with severe thrombocytopenia at delivery had the highest percentage of Cesarean sections.
gest_age: Not mentioned, but mean gestational age at delivery was 39.2 weeks
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but mean birth weight was 3283 g
